run_stretch_teleop: run the Stretch robot Xbox controller teleoperation script to control the robot via joystick input
create_stretch_kinematics_model: create a HelloStretchKinematics model with a URDF path to compute forward and inverse kinematics for the Stretch robot
get_urdf_directory: get the calibrated URDF directory path for the Stretch robot planner using get_urdf_dir
create_xbox_controller: create a StretchXboxController with a kinematics model to map Xbox joystick inputs to robot joint commands
review_teleop_entry_point: review the run_controller_teleop entry point script that wires kinematics and Xbox controller teleop together
